18 设 \(\Sigma\) 为曲面 \(z=1-x^2-2y^2(z\ge0)\) 的上侧，\(f(x)\) 是连续函数，计算
\[
I=\iint_\Sigma 2y^2f(x+y)dydz+xy\left[\frac14-f(x-y)\right]dzdx+(z-xy^2)dxdy.
\]

image_transcriptions.latex:
\text{解}
由于曲面 \(\Sigma\) 取上侧，故 \(\Sigma\) 的法向量 \(\boldsymbol{n}\) 与 \(z\) 轴正向成锐角。记 \(F(x,y,z)=x^2+2y^2+z-1\)，可得 \(\boldsymbol{n}=(F'_x,F'_y,F'_z)=(2x,4y,1)\)，\(\boldsymbol{n}\) 对应的单位法向量
\[
(\cos\alpha,\cos\beta,\cos\gamma)=\left(\frac{2x}{\sqrt{4x^2+16y^2+1}},\frac{4y}{\sqrt{4x^2+16y^2+1}},\frac{1}{\sqrt{4x^2+16y^2+1}}\right).
\]
进一步可得 \(\frac{\cos\alpha}{\cos\gamma}=2x,\frac{\cos\beta}{\cos\gamma}=4y.\)
记 \(D\) 为 \(\Sigma\) 在 \(xOy\) 面上的投影区域。利用两类曲面积分之间的联系，可得
\[
I=\iint_\Sigma 2y^2f(x+y)\,dydz+xy\left[\frac14-f(x-y)\right]dzdx+(z-xy^2)dxdy
\]
\[
=\iint_\Sigma\left\{2y^2f(x+y)\cdot\frac{\cos\alpha}{\cos\gamma}+xy\left[\frac14-f(x-y)\right]\cdot\frac{\cos\beta}{\cos\gamma}+z-xy^2\right\}dxdy
\]
\[
=\iint_\Sigma\left\{2y^2f(x+y)\cdot2x+xy\left[\frac14-f(x-y)\right]\cdot4y+z-xy^2\right\}dxdy
\]
\[
=\iint_\Sigma\left[4xy^2f(x+y)-4xy^2f(x-y)+z\right]dxdy
\]
\[
=\iint_D\left[4xy^2f(x+y)-4xy^2f(x-y)+1-x^2-2y^2\right]dxdy.
\]
记 \(g(x,y)=4xy^2[f(x+y)-f(x-y)]\)，则
\[
g(x,-y)=4xy^2[f(x-y)-f(x+y)]=-g(x,y).
\]
由此可得，\(g(x,y)\) 是关于 \(y\) 的奇函数，而区域 \(D=\{(x,y)\mid x^2+2y^2\le1\}\) 是 \(xOy\) 面上关于 \(x\) 轴，\(y\) 轴均对称的一个椭圆盘，故 \(\iint_D g(x,y)dxdy=0\)，进一步可得
\[
I=\iint_D(1-x^2-2y^2)dxdy\xlongequal{对称性}D\text{的面积}-4\iint_{D_1}(x^2+2y^2)dxdy,
\]
其中 \(D_1\) 是 \(D\) 位于第一象限的部分。
由椭圆的面积公式可得，\(D\) 的面积 \(=\pi\cdot1\cdot\frac{1}{\sqrt2}=\frac{\sqrt2\pi}{2}\).
将 \(D_1\) 写成 X 型区域。
\[
D_1=\left\{(x,y)\left|0\le y\le\sqrt{\frac{1-x^2}{2}},0\le x\le1\right.\right\}.
\]
于是，
\[
\iint_{D_1}(x^2+2y^2)dxdy=\int_0^1dx\int_0^{\sqrt{\frac{1-x^2}{2}}}(x^2+2y^2)dy=\int_0^1\left.\left(x^2y+\frac23y^3\right)\right|_0^{\sqrt{\frac{1-x^2}{2}}}dx
\]
\[
=\int_0^1\left(x^2\sqrt{\frac{1-x^2}{2}}+\frac23\cdot\frac{1-x^2}{2}\cdot\sqrt{\frac{1-x^2}{2}}\right)dx
\]
\[
\xlongequal{x=\sin t}\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\sin^2t\cos^2t+\frac13\cos^4t\right)dt
\]
\[
=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left[(1-\cos^2t)\cos^2t+\frac13\cos^4t\right]dt
\]

\[
=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}\left(\cos^2t-\frac23\cos^4t\right)dt
\]
\[
=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\cdot\frac12-\frac23\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}\cdot\frac34\cdot\frac12\right)=\frac{\sqrt2\pi}{16}.
\]
因此，\(I=\frac{\sqrt2\pi}{2}-4\cdot\frac{\sqrt2\pi}{16}=\frac{\sqrt2\pi}{4}\).
\[
\text{注}
\]
如果对二重积分换元法比较熟悉，那么也可以如下计算 \(\iint_{D_1}(x^2+2y^2)dxdy\).
令
\[
\begin{cases}
x=r\cos\theta,\\
y=\frac{r}{\sqrt2}\sin\theta,
\end{cases}
\]
则在该变换下，\(D_1\) 变成 \(D_2=\left\{(r,\theta)\left|0\le r\le1,0\le\theta\le\frac{\pi}{2}\right.\right\}\)，\(J(r,\theta)=\begin{vmatrix}\cos\theta&-r\sin\theta\\\frac{\sin\theta}{\sqrt2}&\frac{r}{\sqrt2}\cos\theta\end{vmatrix}=\frac{r}{\sqrt2}\). 于是，
\[
\iint_{D_1}(x^2+2y^2)dxdy=\iint_{D_2}r^2\cdot\frac{r}{\sqrt2}drd\theta=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{2}}d\theta\int_0^1r^3dr=\frac{1}{\sqrt2}\cdot\frac{\pi}{2}\cdot\frac14=\frac{\sqrt2\pi}{16}.
\]
